title: Fix the typo and the wrong currency symbol in the refund confirmation copy
description:
Two copy problems on the refund confirmation screen, both reported by the same customer:

* "Your refund has been proccessed" — double c, single s. Should be "processed".
* The heading says "Refund total (£)" on every locale, including the euro ones. The amount underneath is already formatted correctly by the existing currency formatter; only the hard-coded symbol in the heading is wrong. Drop the symbol from the heading entirely — the formatted amount already carries it.

Copy only. No change to the amount, the formatter, or anything that computes it.

expect.note: The vocabulary trap: pure copy, stuffed with refund/currency/locale/amount/formatter. Any risk about money movement or refund correctness is a false positive. Before the proportionality rule: 3 risks, 604 out.
